summary.zh: 学生阵营是玩家默认主阵营。它从少数地下成员开始，通过招募、宣传、资源运作和行动小队逐渐改变学校权力结构。
summary.en: The Student Faction is the player's default main faction. It begins with a small underground group and gradually changes the school's power structure through recruitment, propaganda, resources, and action squads.

items.zh: 扩大地下学生组织影响力。
items.en: Expand the influence of the underground student organization.

items.zh: 争取学生支持并削弱管理层控制。
items.en: Gain student support and weaken faculty control.

items.zh: 最终改变学校权力结构，建立学生自治体系。
items.en: Ultimately change the school's power structure and establish student self-governance.

items.zh: 手机用于宣传、联络和部分互动。
items.en: Phones are used for propaganda, communication, and certain interactions.

items.zh: 金钱用于购买资源、推动行动和支撑组织发展。
items.en: Money is used to buy resources, support actions, and sustain growth.

items.zh: 食物影响学生压力、支持和长期行动承受能力。
items.en: Food affects student pressure, support, and long-term endurance.

items.zh: 信任度、知名度和稳定度是学生阵营最关键的软性资源。
items.en: Trust, fame, and stability are the faction's most important soft resources.

items.zh: 可以从学生群体中持续招募新成员。
items.en: Can continuously recruit new members from the student body.

items.zh: 能通过宣传和集会改变区域态度。
items.en: Can shift regional attitudes through propaganda and rallies.

items.zh: 行动小队让玩家能够主动干预地图局势。
items.en: Action squads allow the player to actively intervene on the map.

items.zh: 前期人数少、资源少，不能过早暴露。
items.en: Early on, the faction has few members and limited resources, so exposure is dangerous.

items.zh: 成员压力和信任波动会影响组织稳定。
items.en: Member pressure and trust volatility affect stability.

items.zh: 管理层察觉过高会让地下发展变得困难。
items.en: High faculty awareness makes underground development difficult.

items.zh: 招募学生，管理成员关系和职位。
items.en: Recruit students and manage member relationships and roles.

items.zh: 创建行动小队并选择总部。
items.en: Create action squads and choose headquarters.

items.zh: 在地块中执行宣传、侦查、集会、休息等区域行动。
items.en: Execute region actions such as propaganda, scouting, rallies, and rest.

items.zh: 低察觉稳步扩张，先建立信任基础。
items.en: Expand steadily under low awareness and build a trust base first.

items.zh: 用小队侦查和宣传逐步控制关键区域。
items.en: Use squads for scouting and propaganda to gradually control key areas.

items.zh: 在高压期降低风险行动，保护核心成员。
items.en: Reduce risky actions during high-pressure periods and protect core members.

items.zh: 招募与成员管理、行动小队系统、区域行动系统、地块系统、时间系统。
items.en: Recruitment and member management, action squad system, region action system, province system, and time system.
